Outline · not written yet

This is the planned structure of the chapter, published so the curriculum can be reviewed before the prose is written. Each heading below becomes a section; the last section is what you will build and test. About 60 minutes when written.

8.1 · Sampling variance

temperature, n samples per item, and pass@k against pass^k.

8.2 · Prompt sensitivity

formatting and wording changes that move scores more than models do.

8.3 · Nondeterminism in inference

batch size and kernel choice change outputs; batch-invariant inference.

8.4 · Decomposing variance

items, samples and seeds, and where to spend the budget.

8.5 · Worked example

a "2-point regression" that is 80% prompt formatting.

What you build

A variance-decomposition harness; a demonstration of batch-dependent outputs on one model. Every number it produces is asserted by a test, and the chapter's companion notebook recomputes it.
